summary: Sandbach United got their 2026/27 season off to a winning start with a 1-0 victory over Stafford Town at home, with a first-half goal from Tatters proving decisive. The Bach controlled the match well enough to secure a clean sheet, with keeper Hall making some important saves to keep Stafford at bay in the second half. It was a solid opening day performance that suggests the team will be competitive in their league campaign.
